decision: Close the full-feature linear plus three-route sparse analytic coefficient realization without ridge, route, rank, data, seed, or solver variants. The stable objectives and training fit are valid, but both held-out quality gates fail while the identical rank-935 direct-coefficient span passes. Authorize one read-only source-aligned nonlinear coefficient oracle behind the same factorized attention and residual basis to determine whether the frozen source SwiGLU activations carry the missing conditional information before any compressed nonlinear host is proposed.
claim_boundary: Negative layer-1 analytic coefficient-realization evidence only; no component, installed host, physical runtime, autonomous, complete-model, Phase 3, or superiority claim.
